as_told.title: Naval Intelligence offered Spielberg a deal after Jaws

plain: The story goes that after Jaws made Steven Spielberg a big name in the mid-1970s, men from Naval Intelligence approached him and offered him a deal, and he took it. If true, the director's later alien films would have a government hand behind them. A guest named Brent Friedman says he heard it around 1995 in Newhall, California, from the director Tobe Hooper: Spielberg "got approached by some guys from naval intelligence or something" who "offered him a deal." Another guest on the same episode repeats the account and adds that Spielberg accepted. A clip played in a later episode also credits Hooper but does not say whether Spielberg took the deal.
